import re, os, sqlite3, sys
f = "workplan/2026-10-23-pipeline-resolution-workplan.md"
txt = open(f).read()
spans = set(re.findall(r"`([^`\n]+)`", txt))
S = "scratchpad/session_2026-10-22-pipeline-stress-test/"
pathlike = [s for s in spans if re.search(r"\.(py|md|yaml|sh|json|tsv)$", s) and " " not in s and "<" not in s and "*" not in s]
missing = []
for p in sorted(pathlike):
    if not any(os.path.exists(x) for x in (p, S + p, "scripts/" + p, "decisions/" + p)):
        missing.append(p)
print("path-like tokens:", len(pathlike), "| missing:", missing)
c = sqlite3.connect("file:data/guidebook.db?mode=ro", uri=True)
objs = {r[0] for r in c.execute("select name from sqlite_master")}
vtok = sorted(s for s in spans if re.fullmatch(r"v_\w+", s))
print("views cited:", [(v, v in objs) for v in vtok])
tabs = sorted(s for s in spans if re.fullmatch(r"[a-z_]+", s) and s in objs and not s.startswith("v_"))
print("tables cited that exist:", tabs)
PY
